title: 01Blog
tagline: A blogging platform for students, with JWT authentication, roles and moderation. Spring Boot API, Angular frontend.
summary: A social blogging platform where students share what they learn. I built it alone: a REST API in Spring Boot secured with Spring Security and JWT, an Angular frontend, media uploads, likes, comments, subscriptions, and an admin area for moderation.
problem: Students needed one place to publish what they learn, follow each other and react to posts. The platform also needed moderation, so admins can manage content and users without touching the database by hand.
role: Solo project. I designed the database, built the Spring Boot API and its security, and wrote the Angular frontend.
features: Registration and login with JWT, and role-based access (user and admin)
Likes, comments and subscriptions to other students
Admin tools to moderate content and manage users
A REST API used by an Angular single-page app

challenges.title: Securing every endpoint by role
challenges.problem: Every request must say who is calling and what they are allowed to do. Admin actions must be impossible for normal users, even if they call the API directly.
challenges.solution: Spring Security with stateless JWT authentication: the token is checked on every request, and endpoints are restricted by role (USER or ADMIN). [TODO: add one detail, for example how your JWT filter works]

challenges.title: A consistent relational model
challenges.problem: Users, posts, comments, likes and subscriptions are all linked. The data must stay consistent when a post or a user is deleted.
challenges.solution: A relational schema with foreign keys between users, posts, comments, likes and subscriptions. [TODO: explain how you handled deletions, for example cascades or soft deletes]
